title: Experts disagree on src/delivery/delivery-check.ts saveDeliveryReading
context:
Chief architect: Both claims can hold at once and the build should honour both; it is ruled a pick only because a must-level security-auditor finding is part of it, so the owner confirms. Recommend the execFile args-array and 40-hex check; it lives inside saveDeliveryReading as the single writer of push for Stop and refresh, as the architect asked.

Target: src/delivery/delivery-check.ts saveDeliveryReading
- security-auditor: the push check runs git rev-parse @{upstream} and HEAD through execFile with an args array; a branch name or upstream ref is never passed into a shell, and a non-40-hex output is treated as no reading rather than written to delivery.json
- application-architect: the push reading (state pushed, sha) belongs in saveDeliveryReading beside pr and ci, computed from git rev-parse via execFile args, so Stop and the new refresh verb share one writer of delivery.json push
